validation.title: Validation
validation.lede: What the model said, against what an instrument in the water actually measured.
validation.eventHint: Only the anchor event has an instrumented record. Every other event returns no record by design.
validation.plainSalinity: Salinity fell sharply as the flood water arrived — a drop far outside normal variation for this site.
validation.plainTurbidity: Suspended sediment peaked well above background, which is the signal the plume model is trying to reproduce.
validation.plainDuration: The water stayed disturbed for well over a day before returning to background.
validation.plainMass: The reported total sediment mass for the event, from the published record rather than from our model.
validation.markersNote: Each marker carries its own provenance: measured, reported, converted or modelled. They are not all the same kind of number.
validation.seriesUnavailable: The full five-minute time series is not served by the API — only the summary quantities above. The chart therefore shows the markers, not the raw trace.
validation.modelledBody: The modelled arrival and duration are not shown as a comparison line here, because the term they depend on is not yet available end to end.
validation.forcingPlaceholder: The plume that would be compared here runs with placeholder forcing on this checkout: ocean currents fall back to a constant zero field, and wind is always zero. A comparison drawn against that would be measuring our placeholder, not our physics.
validation.calibrationBody: Parameters were fitted to the measured timing over {{n}} trials. The fit targets arrival and duration — timing only, not concentration.
validation.satelliteVerdict: This is a measured finding, not an unfinished task.
validation.satelliteBody: There is no usable satellite image of this plume. We checked rather than assumed.
validation.satelliteElevated: The plume was elevated for roughly 31 hours after arrival, then dispersed.
validation.satellitePassOne: First usable overpass: +104 hours after arrival.
validation.satellitePassTwo: Second usable overpass: +128 hours after arrival.
validation.physicalNullBody: Two sensors, no plume. By the time either satellite passed over, there was nothing left in the water to photograph. This is why the mooring is the validation target and a hand-drawn satellite mask is not.
validation.noRecordTitle: No measured record for this event
validation.noRecordBody: There is no instrumented record for {{eventId}}.
validation.noRecordNotError: This is expected, not a failure. Exactly one event in the record has a mooring deployment behind it.

provenance.title: Provenance
provenance.lede: Every layer, and the figure that proves it is right.
provenance.sourcesLive: Served live from the API's provenance ledger.
provenance.sourcesEmptyBody: The provenance ledger could not be reached. The figures above are served from the committed snapshot and are unaffected.

limitations.title: Honest limits
limitations.lede: What this system cannot do, stated plainly and on purpose.
limitations.arabicPending: Arabic translation pending — the body below is shown in its source language rather than machine-translated.
limitations.reefTitle: Reef sensitivity weight is a placeholder
limitations.reefPlaceholder: Every reef zone currently carries a sensitivity weight of 1.0. That is a placeholder awaiting marine-scientist review, not a measured value — so exposure scores rank zones against each other, but the absolute number is not calibrated.
limitations.reefUnavailable: Reef zone status could not be read from the API.
limitations.forcingBody: The particle engine runs with a constant zero wind field. No historical marine wind source exists for this basin — the available forecast products are forecast-only, and the reanalysis product is land-only. The winning windage value from calibration is therefore a tie-break artefact, not a calibrated parameter.
limitations.forcingUnavailable: Forcing detail could not be read from the API.

assistant.title: Explain / Ask
assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.lede: Ask about the method, the data or the limits. Every answer is quoted from the project's own documents.
assistant.placeholder: Ask a question about the method, data or limitations…
assistant.extractive: This assistant retrieves passages and quotes them. There is no language model anywhere in this path — it cannot paraphrase, and it cannot invent a number.
assistant.corpusBoundary: It can only answer from the project's technical documents. Market and research material is deliberately outside the corpus.
assistant.noAnswerBody: Nothing in the corpus supports an answer to that question. Rather than compose one anyway, the assistant returns nothing — an uncited answer is not shown as an answer.
assistant.unreachableBody: The retrieval service could not be reached, so no question can be answered right now.

suggestions.satellite: Why is satellite validation a no-go for the demo event?
suggestions.currents: What ocean current data does the plume model use?
suggestions.sensitivity: What is the reef sensitivity weight and is it calibrated?
suggestions.transmission: What is transmission loss and where does the value come from?
suggestions.market: Who are the intended users of this system?

reports.title: Reports
reports.lede: Post-event forensic reports, assembled from stored runs with a source behind every claim.
reports.noListEndpoint: The API exposes no endpoint that lists previously generated reports.
reports.noListBody: Only reports generated or looked up in this browser session appear below. Earlier reports still exist on the server and can be opened by ID, but they cannot be enumerated from here.
reports.emptyBody: Generate one from an event above, or open an existing report by its ID.
reports.draftedMeaning: Machine-assembled draft. Every claim is quoted and sourced, but no person has checked it.
reports.reviewedMeaning: A named person has reviewed and signed off on this report.
reports.reviewerHint: Recorded as stated. There is no account system, so this name is not authenticated.
reports.pdfBlocked: Pop-up blocked — allow pop-ups for this site to download the PDF.

failed.generate: Could not generate the report. The service may be unreachable.
failed.fetch: No report found for that ID, or the service is unreachable.
failed.review: Could not record the review. The service may be unreachable.

sites.title: Site scoring
sites.lede: Score a candidate coastline against the six transfer criteria.
sites.bboxHint: West, south, east, north in decimal degrees.
sites.invalidBbox: Enter four numbers, with west below east and south below north.
sites.idle: Enter a bounding box to score a candidate coastline.

criterion.C3: Reef or seagrass within a few kilometres

sites.insufficientBody: No score is given where the underlying data does not cover this area. A missing score is left missing rather than guessed.
sites.oneSite: This scorer has been validated on exactly one site. Treat a score for anywhere else as indicative only.
sites.failedBody: The scoring service could not be reached, or rejected the bounding box.

account.title: Preferences
account.lede: Language and theme for this browser.
account.noAuthBody: This platform has no authentication: no accounts, no sign-in, no sessions. The dashboard is open access to anyone who can reach it.
account.noAuthConsequence: So there is no profile to show here, and no permissions to manage. Where the interface asks for a reviewer's name, that name is recorded as typed and is not verified against anything.
account.languageHint: Applies across the whole application, including map labels and text direction. Saved in this browser.
account.themeHint: System follows your device setting. Saved in this browser.

notFound.title: No such page
notFound.body: That address does not match any page in this application.

formula.title: Exposure formula
formula.mismatchBody: The factors do not multiply to the expected raw score. Computed {{computed}}, expected {{expected}}.

placeholder.sensitivity: This is a placeholder value (1.0) awaiting marine-scientist review, not a measured sensitivity weight. Every exposure score for this zone is multiplied by this number.
placeholder.generic: This value is flagged as provisional: {{flag}}. It may change when real data becomes available.

sampling.title: Adaptive sampling
sampling.dampenRule: Feedback can only dampen the score, never inflate it. Bounded to [0, risk_score].
sampling.infrastructureNote: This feature is infrastructure for a capability that activates after real deployment history. It cannot be meaningfully demonstrated with zero field observations.
sampling.noFeedback: No feedback yet — adjusted priority equals risk score exactly.

systemHealth.lede: Live diagnostics from the running API.
systemHealth.unreachable: The API could not be reached, so no live diagnostics are available.
systemHealth.degradedModel: The runoff model artefact is not registered.
systemHealth.degradedData: The data volume is not mounted.
systemHealth.degradedStatus: The API reports a non-OK status.
systemHealth.cacheUnavailable: Cache statistics are not available — the endpoint did not respond.
systemHealth.artifactNote: Per-artifact availability is not exposed by the API contract yet; the availability signals above are what /health reports.
